data.marketLevelRationale: Bootcamp graduate with 2 months post-graduation, no professional employment history, and one portfolio project (to-do list app). Self-assessment claims of 'world-class senior architect' with '10 years experience' directly contradict documented timeline. Actual experience is ~2 months practical coding. Entry-level assessment is based on verifiable facts, not claims.

salaryRange.note: Entry-level remote software developer market in 2024. Target of $10,000/month is 2.2x-4.2x above realistic range for this experience level. Remote positions for bootcamp grads typically offer $28,800-$54,000 annually.

coreStrengths.evidence: Graduated from bootcamp 2 months ago, indicating baseline completion of full-stack or specialized curriculum
Shipped a working to-do list application, proving ability to build functional features end-to-end
Seeking remote work indicates adaptability to modern work environments and geographic flexibility

criticalGaps.impact: No demonstrated ability to work in team environments, meet production timelines, code review processes, or enterprise standards. No references from employers. Significantly limits marketability.

criticalGaps.gap: Severe disconnect between self-assessment and reality
criticalGaps.impact: Claims of '10 years experience' and 'world-class senior architect' when bootcamp graduate 2 months ago raises red flags about judgment, self-awareness, or honesty. Employers conducting background checks will identify this immediately and may eliminate candidate.

criticalGaps.gap: No degree and no professional credibility markers
criticalGaps.evidence: Lacks formal degree. Only credential is recent bootcamp. Many enterprise and mid-size employers filter out candidates without degree or significant employment history, especially combined with no prior work experience.
criticalGaps.impact: Reduces applicant pool to startups and smaller companies only. Narrows opportunities.

criticalGaps.gap: Insufficient portfolio depth for competitive market
criticalGaps.impact: Single to-do list project is common bootcamp capstone. Not differentiated. Needs 3-5 diverse projects showcasing problem-solving, technical depth, and deployment skills to stand out among 1000s of bootcamp graduates per year.

data.uniqueValueProposition: Bootcamp graduate with hands-on project delivery experience seeking entry-level remote opportunities to build professional coding discipline and team collaboration skills.
data.readinessNote: Candidate is 2 months post-bootcamp with a single portfolio project and zero job offers. Market readiness is critically low due to: (1) no professional experience, (2) inflated self-assessment creating trust concerns, (3) single weak portfolio project, (4) target salary 2-4x above realistic market for this level. Candidate needs 6-12 months of gap-closing (multiple portfolio projects, first junior role at realistic salary $2,400-$4,500/month, networking, technical depth) before being competitive for mid-market opportunities. Score reflects: 22% = below-threshold for most employers, but not zero because bootcamp completion + shipped project + motivated to work remotely provide foundation.
